artists.biography: Drawing on the singular talents of vocalist and producer Lorenzo Esposito Fornasari (Berserk!, Obake), innovative guitarist Carmelo Pipitone (Marta sui Tubi) and internationally renowned musicians Pat Mastelotto (King Crimson) and Colin Edwin (Porcupine Tree) O.R.k. is an intriguing collaborative album which defies easy categorization yet remains gratifyingly accessible. Debut album “Inflamed rides” fuses primordial energy with playful acoustic psychedelia and precise math rock, but with an added seasoning of intense ambient electronica. Across the ten tracks, O.R.k illuminate a deep subconscious landscape, rich with controlled chaos and populated with archetypal forms and characters. Highlights include the mezmerising ‘Pyre’, accompanied by a stunning animated video from Oktopus Productions and the jarring urgency of “Funfair” which promises entertaining rides in the most intimidating manner. Imposing, but also encompassing a hypnotic, powerful beauty, O.R.k. is a forward thinking, mischievous slap around the head of complacency, and a captivating listen from start to finish. Lorenzo Esposito Fornasari (aka Lef) – vocals, keys Carmelo Pipitone – guitars Colin Edwin – bass Pat Mastelotto – drums Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Released in 2017 via RareNoise Records, Soul of an Octopus is the second studio album by O.R.k., a progressive rock band featuring vocalist Lorenzo Esposito Fornasari, guitarist Carmelo Pipitone, bassist Colin Edwin, and drummer Pat Mastelotto. The album is characterized by its atmospheric soundscapes, dynamic rhythms, and a blend of alternative, progressive, and art rock elements. O.R.k. crafts a moody and introspective sonic palette, combining brooding vocals, intricate guitar work, and subtle electronic textures, resulting in a sound that is both expansive and emotionally resonant.

Soul of an Octopus solidified O.R.k.'s reputation as a distinctive voice in the modern progressive rock scene, building on the promise of their debut while exploring darker, more experimental territory. The album received positive critical attention for its cohesive songwriting and atmospheric depth, with reviewers noting its emotional intensity and innovative arrangements. Though not a mainstream commercial breakthrough, it was well-regarded among fans of progressive and alternative rock, further establishing the band’s presence within the genre and earning praise for its originality and musicianship.
